commission_entries_reversal_link.name: commission_entries_reversal_link
commission_entries_reversal_link.value:
("commission_entries"."entry_type" = 'reversal' AND "commission_entries"."reverses_entry_id" IS NOT NULL)
       OR ("commission_entries"."entry_type" <> 'reversal' AND "commission_entries"."reverses_entry_id" IS NULL)

commission_rules_basis_fields.name: commission_rules_basis_fields
commission_rules_basis_fields.value:
("commission_rules"."basis" = 'percentage' AND "commission_rules"."rate_pct" IS NOT NULL)
       OR ("commission_rules"."basis" = 'fixed_per_deal' AND "commission_rules"."fixed_amount" IS NOT NULL)
       OR ("commission_rules"."basis" = 'tiered')

opportunities_lost_requires_reason.name: opportunities_lost_requires_reason
opportunities_lost_requires_reason.value: "opportunities"."stage_key" NOT IN ('lost', 'declined', 'withdrawn') OR "opportunities"."loss_reason_key" IS NOT NULL
